summary: Validate common CMSIS-Pack PDSC sequence XML and C-like block formatting through the active conversation after a proposed or applied change, returning commands, inspected matches, failures, resolutions, and `PASS` or `FAIL`.
triggers: debug or trace PDSC sequence edits
verification: Run and inspect every relevant match from `rg -n '<block>.*;</block>' <target.pdsc>` and `rg -n '^[[:space:]]*[^<].*;.*;' <target.pdsc>`.
Resolve each C-like match; one-line block bodies and multiple statements on one line fail validation.
When the requested change also affects an SVD, run `svdconv`; when pack consumption must be checked, register or install the local PDSC or pack with `cpackget`.

Use the current Debug Description specification for sequence grammar; `packchk` with `-i` options for PDSC and dependency-pack validation; and the two required `rg` checks for block-format inspection.
Use `cpackget` to check local-pack registration or installation when required, and `svdconv` for an affected SVD.
stop_conditions: Stop when `packchk` or required XML/PDSC validation cannot run, a required match remains unresolved, or the target PDSC is unavailable.

rules.delta: syntax, formatting, or toolchain validation passed without running and inspecting the required checks

extracted.title: Validate a PDSC with packchk and its required packs
extracted.body: Validate XML/PDSC syntax with `packchk <target.pdsc>` and include every required pack through its `-i` option.

extracted.title: C-like block layout in PDSC sequences and its rg checks
extracted.body:
Require matching XML-tag alignment. Require C-like content to start after `<block>`, be indented one level inside it, use one semicolon-terminated statement per line, and preserve XML entities.

Run and inspect every relevant match from `rg -n '<block>.*;</block>' <target.pdsc>` and `rg -n '^[[:space:]]*[^<].*;.*;' <target.pdsc>`. Resolve each C-like match; one-line block bodies and multiple statements on one line fail validation.
